Revisit quince: an answer's verdict is structure burlap

Generating mock-control at f02528f, which has three new plans (vellum, ferrule, tallow), showed two things phoropter gets wrong that don't need a cart. Plans overwrite each other's pages, and as-builts in grommet's kinds (aide plans/2026-10-30-grommet.md) render without a kind. Revisits (bodkin) and anchors from one plan into another wait for a cart.

Decision: A plan's page is named by its filename, not its cart

where src/site.ts file page

quote const href = `plans/${slugify(cart)}/`;

Because (measured): vellum, ferrule, and tallow all say cart: none; Jeff handed mock-control's next plans to Claude, so all three wrote one page and two were lost. Lanyard makes the cart optional and puts the meaningless name in the filename, which is unique by construction. 2026-10-30-vellum.md is vellum. The cart stays on the page as a fact, as written. Where a page names a plan in passing ("in pumice"), it uses the filename's name too.

Decision: Chose: and Answered: are kinds, wherever they appear

where src/plan.ts file page

quote const match = /^(Decision|Decline|Guess|Changed):\s*(.*)$/.exec(token.text);

Because (grommet): grommet defines them, and vellum's, ferrule's, and tallow's as-builts use them. Old as-builts keep Changed: as written, so Changed: stays.

Decision: An Answered: links to the plan's Guess: with the same title, and back

where src/render.ts file page

no quote, so nothing to search for

Because (grommet, Claude): grommet titles an answer with its guess's own title so the two can be paired. All four answers in mock-control match their guesses exactly. The rels are answers (answer to guess) and answered-by (guess to answer), defined in the profile like the others. An answer with no matching guess says so in plain words.

Decline: Reading the verdict (held, disproved, not tested) out of an answer's prose

Anchored by burlap, Decision: What moved is our understanding, not the world or the code.

Because (Claude): grommet puts it in the prose, and parsing prose for a word is the kind of guess the HTML shouldn't carry as structure. The answer's text is one link away from the guess.

Decline: Checking which kinds belong in a plan and which in an as-built

Because (Claude): lanyard: the tool never flags. A Chose: in a plan renders as a Chose:.

Decline: Linking vellum's answer to pumice's guess

where mock-control: plans/2026-10-30-vellum.as-built.md › Tailwind finds the panel's classes through the `@source` line

in mock-control, which this site doesn't read

Because (Jeff and Claude): it answers a guess in another plan, which is a link from one plan into another. That's the cart's question.

Guess: An exact title match is enough to pair an answer with its guess

Answered in the as-built: held.

Disproved if: an Answered: title drifts from its guess's title (a typo, a rephrase) and the page shows a real answer as unpaired.
